display.purpose: Page-level editorial headings and modal/drawer titles.

body.purpose: All operational UI controls, tables, and notes.

caption.purpose: Table column headers, badge chips, and compact metadata.

micro.purpose: Calendar day pills and inline keycap hints.

mono.purpose: Live session timer clock, timestamps, and keycap hints.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Floating slide-over drawers, command palette, and printable statement dialog.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: 150ms transitions on buttons, borders, and controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary studio action button in Deep Botanical Forest.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #1B4D3E); color: var(--accent-ink, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; padding: 6px 14px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #143B2F); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #1B4D3E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink-primary, #171614); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #CFC7B8); border-radius: 7px; padding: 6px 12px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle, #EAE5DA); }

components.name: Ledger Input
components.description: Form field with control stroke and Deep Botanical focus state.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink-primary, #171614); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #CFC7B8); border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 10px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #1B4D3E); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact status chip for payment and task priority states.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; background: var(--sage-tint, #E9F3ED); color: var(--sage, #256347); }

components.name: Ledger Sheet
components.description: Flat 1px-bordered white paper container for tables and split views.
components.css: .ds-sheet { background: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--border, #E5E0D5); border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; color: var(--ink-primary, #171614); font-size: 14px; }

narrative.overview: Atelier Ledger treats everyday prep tasks, private tutoring sessions across four billing models, and studio bookkeeping as one unified paper-and-ink workstation. Rather than generic SaaS card grids or dark neon dashboards, the surface relies on warm archival paper (#F6F4EF), crisp hairline-divided sheets (#FFFFFF over 1px parchment borders), Deep Botanical Forest actions (#1B4D3E), and Terracotta highlights (#C2592B).
keyCharacteristics: Daylight-first paper canvas (#F6F4EF) paired with a stone navigation rail (#EFECE4).
Editorial serif headings (Newsreader) anchored over clean sans-serif controls (Instrument Sans) and monospace clocks (JetBrains Mono).
Universal tabular-nums alignment across every fee, duration, balance, countdown, and table column.
Slide-over detail drawers preserve underlying table/calendar scroll position during edits.

rules.name: The One-Accent Action Rule
rules.body: Deep Botanical Forest (#1B4D3E) belongs to primary actions, active selections, and positive earned bars; semantic status badges use muted Sage, Ochre, and Crimson tints instead of saturated fills.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: Every monetary amount, duration, date, count, and timer uses tabular-nums so columns align vertically like an accounting sheet.

rules.name: The Flat-Sheet Rule
rules.body: Never combine a 1px card border with a diffuse drop shadow on resting workspace panels.

dos: Do format every price, duration, date, and metric with tabular-nums.
Do use 1px hairline grid dividers (gap-px over #E5E0D5) for multi-column summary strips.
Do keep Ink Dark Mode (#151412) warm and restrained, matching the paper register.
donts: Don't add gradient backgrounds, glassmorphism blur, or neon borders.
Don't place kickers/eyebrows above headings or decorative emojis inside UI labels.
Don't place one-sided vertical accent bars on rounded containers.
